evals.prompt: Create a skill called 'data-pipeline' that teaches agents how to run our ETL scripts
evals.expected_output: Full skill created in .agents/skills/data-pipeline/: SKILL.md with frontmatter, procedure, Gotchas, Validation. evals/evals.json with ≥5 cases. validate-frontmatter.sh run and all checks pass.
assertions: Skill directory and SKILL.md are created
frontmatter name field matches directory name exactly
SKILL.md has ## Gotchas section
SKILL.md has ## Validation section
evals/evals.json exists with at least 2 should_trigger:false near-miss cases
validate-frontmatter.sh is run and reports all checks passed

evals.prompt: This flat file docs/api-reference.md needs to be a proper skill so agents can use it
evals.expected_output: Flat file converted to proper skill structure. SKILL.md created with frontmatter, description, procedure. Detail tables moved to references/. evals added. validate-frontmatter.sh passes.
assertions: SKILL.md is created with valid frontmatter
Tables longer than 10 rows are moved to references/ with conditional triggers
validate-frontmatter.sh reports all checks passed

evals.prompt: Audit the failure-handling skill — does it fully comply with the agentskills.io spec?
evals.expected_output: validate-frontmatter.sh run first. Each failed check identified and fixed. Script re-run to confirm all pass.
assertions: validate-frontmatter.sh is run before any edits
Each failed check is addressed
validate-frontmatter.sh re-run after edits shows all checks passed

evals.prompt: The discovery-and-routing skill description isn't triggering reliably on agent routing questions
evals.expected_output: Description revised with imperative phrasing, implicit triggers, and near-miss exclusions. Character count verified < 1024.
assertions: Revised description uses imperative phrasing
Implicit trigger phrases added
Character count checked and confirmed < 1024

evals.prompt: Add eval test cases to the configuration skill — it currently has none
evals.expected_output: evals/evals.json created with ≥3 should-trigger and ≥2 should-not-trigger near-miss cases. Each case has assertions.
assertions: evals/evals.json has at least 3 should_trigger:true cases
evals/evals.json has at least 2 should_trigger:false cases that are near-misses
Each eval has an assertions array

evals.prompt: turn this into a proper skill
evals.expected_output: Skill activates — implicit trigger 'turn this into a proper skill' matches the description. Source material (current file context) is read before writing.
assertions: Source material is read before SKILL.md is written
validate-frontmatter.sh is run at the end

evals.prompt: Implement the sessions_cancel handler in src/mcp/tools/sessions.ts
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT activate — this is a code implementation task, not skill creation.
assertions: No SKILL.md is created
No validate-frontmatter.sh is run
Handler is implemented in the source file directly

evals.prompt: Update the README to document the new Factory API
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT activate — this is README/documentation writing, not SKILL.md creation.
assertions: No SKILL.md is created
README.md is edited directly
